summaryZh: Zhaowei Liu Research Group 研究纳米光子学、纳米结构材料与等离激元，探索光电子和生物科学应用。方向包括超分辨高速显微、计算成像与光谱、超材料、集成光学及量子传感。研究组自述工作通常结合工程设计与优化、器件制备与表征。

evidence.quote: Zhaowei Liu Research Group UCSD | Jacobs School of Engineering

Detailed research topics include but not limited to: super-resolution high speed microscopy, biophotonics, computational imaging and spectroscopy, plasmonics and metamaterials, extreme nonlinearities and integrated optics, nanoscale light sources, and quantum sensing.

The research topics transcend the boundaries of traditional disciplines and are typically a combination of fundamental science exploration, engineering design and optimization, device fabrication and characterization, and various applications.
